title: Thunder
html:
For other possible meanings of Thunder in the game, see:  Thunder (disambiguation)

⁠Thunder is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Thunder, see Category:Sources of Thunder damage.
  • For creatures weak to Thunder, see Category:Vulnerable to Thunder.
  • For creatures resistant to Thunder, see Category:Resistant to Thunder.
  • For creatures immune to Thunder, see Category:Immune to Thunder.

Sources of Thunder damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Thunder damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Spells

  •  Booming Blade
  •  Chromatic Orb: Thunder
  •  Destructive Wave
  •  Destructive Wave: Necrotic
  •  Destructive Wave: Radiant
  •  Glyph of Warding: Thunder
  •  Shatter
  •  Thunderous Smite
  •  Thunderwave

Class actions

  •  Fist of Four Thunders
  •  Gong of the Summit
  •  Heart of the Storm: Thunder
  •  Sphere of Elemental Balance: Thunder

Special actions

  •  Divine Strike: Thunder
  •  Divine Strike: Thunder (Melee)
  •  Divine Strike: Thunder (Ranged)
  •  Elemental Cleaver (thunder)
  •  Grand Slam
  •  Grounded Thunder Strike
  •  Gushing Air
  •  Phalar Aluve: Shriek
  •  Zephyr Break
  •  Zephyr Flash

Weapons

The following weapons deal Thunder damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Cacophony
  •  Corpsegrinder
  •  Nyrulna

Equipment

The following equipment add Thunder damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Thunder damage through other means.

  •  Hamarhraft: Jumps deal +1d4⁠⁠Thunder in an area.
  •  Ring of Absolute Force: A wearer with the Brand of the Absolute deals +1⁠⁠Thunder upon dealing thunder damage.
  •  Thunderpalm Strikers: Unarmed attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Thunder.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Thunder damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Concussion Grenade: Deal 5d10+18⁠⁠Thunder in an area.  DEX Save (DC 18) to halve damage.

Interactions

  •  Gloves of Belligerent Skies: When the wielder deals ⁠Radiant, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Thunder damage, apply 2 turns of  Reverberation to the target(s).
  •  Hat of Storm Scion's Power: Upon dealing thunder damage, gain  Arcane Acuity.
  •  Ring of Spiteful Thunder: Upon dealing thunder damage to a target under  Reverberation, inflict  Dazed if the creature fails a  CON Save (DC 13).

Notes

  • The  Arrow of Roaring Thunder does not, in fact, deal any thunder damage.
